sources.entry: Comicory - AI comic generator that produces multi-panel stories with character consistency across frames.

summary.name: Comicory
summary.one_liner: Comicory is an AI comic generator that turns a written story into multi-panel comics with consistent characters, editable panels, and PDF, PNG, or ZIP exports.
use_cases: Turn a short story into a paneled comic
Create a manga or webtoon page from a script
Build a multi-chapter comic series with the same cast
Make a comic strip with a short setup and punchline
Draw a comic featuring your own original characters
summary.what_it_does: Comicory takes a story or paragraph, drafts a panel-by-panel script with dialogue for review, then renders the panels in one of 21 art styles. It generates a locked reference portrait for each character and conditions panels on that image to help keep characters and locations consistent. Users can edit speech bubbles separately, redraw a brushed area or a whole panel, and choose page layouts such as splash, strip, grid, or webtoon column. Finished comics can be exported as a multi-page PDF, high-res PNG pages, a long scrolling PNG, or a ZIP of panels and pages. A Continue Story feature adds new chapters that reuse the existing cast and style.
notable: Character reference portraits condition each panel to help keep characters consistent
Continue Story feature adds new chapters reusing cast and style
21 art styles, with 10 available on free credits
Fix Area brush tool redraws only the painted part of a panel
caveats: Free accounts get 10 one-time credits; more credits or plans cost money (credit packs from $4.99, Creator Pack $19.99)
Free exports carry a Comicory watermark
Character consistency can drift on difficult angles, small faces, and group scenes; review needed
11 of the 21 art styles require a paid plan
